cause: GLTFLoader sanitizes the circular glass mesh names with underscores. The old space-only match failed and selected rectangular light diffusion.
fix: Recognize imported and original names; derive continuous circular glow coordinates in each glass disc's own plane, independent of rim normals and building heading.
preserved: Original GLB, every window position/index/normal, daytime glass, palettes, window brightness, map layout and resolution.
baseLightFollowUp: Removed only the Jardine House low window-spill point light that burned a bright patch into the base. Building identities now survive scene serialization so this exclusion is exact and does not select a replacement light. Other three spill positions and intensities are unchanged.
regression: All 144 actual GLB panes are checked across three building headings for the circular flag, circular perimeter coordinates and unchanged geometry/topology.
browser: Front close-ups verified in daylight and at night. Side view was occluded by the neighbouring tower; all four facades are covered by the geometry checks.
